text: Concatenate to output Concatenate to output Concatenate to output 3 channels 32+3=35 channels 32+35=67 channels 32+67=99 channels Figure 11.9 DenseNet. This architecture uses residual connections to concatenate the outputs of earlier layers to later ones. Here, the three-channel input image is processed to form a 32-channel representation. The input image is concatenated to this to give a total of 35 channels. This combined representation is processed to create another 32-channel representation, and both earlier representations are concatenated to this to create a total of 67 channels and so on.
